# Future Foundation School & College
> Future Foundation School (FFS) is a premier educational institution network in Pakistan founded in 1998, with over 70 campuses nationwide offering Montessori to College level education, AI & Robotics, STEAM learning, and Islamic character building.

## Core Information
- **Name**: Future Foundation School & College (FFS)
- **Founded**: 1998
- **Campuses**: 70+ locations across Pakistan
- **Head Office**: Baraf Khana Chowk, Misrial Road, Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 370 750 3109
- **Email**: futuredocuments786@gmail.com
- **Official Website**: https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk

## Key Pages & Resources
- [Home](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/): Overview of school philosophy, leadership, academic curriculum, and facilities.
- [Online Admissions](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/admissionnow): Apply online for student admissions across Montessori, Primary, Middle, High School, and College.
- [Admission Process](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/admission-process): Step-by-step guidance on admission criteria, documentation, and assessments.
- [Campus Network](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/our-campuses): Explore 70+ campus locations across Pakistan.
- [Franchise Model](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/franchise-model): Information on becoming a franchise school partner.
- [AI & Robotics](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/ai-robotics): Modern STEM curriculum covering coding, robotics, and artificial intelligence.
- [STEAM Learning](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/steam): Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics integration.
- [Montessori Wing](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/montessori-wing): Early childhood education focusing on sensorial and practical life skills.
- [Contact Us](https://futurefoundationschool.edu.pk/contact-us): Official contact details, map location, and inquiry form.
